paper_title: First Axion-Like Particle Results from a Broadband Search for Wave-Like Dark Matter in the 44 to 52 $μ$eV Range with a Coaxial Dish Antenna
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, exactly as plotted on linear y-axis with x10^-11 multiplier
notes: First ALP (axion-photon) search with a dish antenna (BREAD/GigaBREAD) in 3.9 T solenoid at Argonne, covering 44-52 ueV (10.7-12.5 GHz), 90% CL. Coupling type is unambiguous (g_agamma), and the exclusion is genuinely new. However, the paper provides NO numerical limit values in text or tables - the limit is only shown in Fig. 3 (not machine-readable here). The emitted coupling value ~5e-11 GeV^-1 is an ESTIMATE inferred from the paper's claim of 'most stringent laboratory constraints in this mass range' (i.e., surpassing CAST's ~6.6e-11 GeV^-1) combined with signal-power scaling from Eq. 2; treat the coupling values as approximate (order-of-magnitude reliable, factor ~2 uncertain). Mass endpoints correspond to the stated 44-52 ueV coverage. DM density assumption 0.45 GeV/cm^3 explicit in Eq. 2.
